description: Reviewed GOAT list (compiler input, scripts/compile-legends.mjs): the handful of players the game’s followers put in the greatest-of-all-time conversation, each at the World Cup cycles of his peak — a GOAT card is a player AND an era (his card in his nation’s pool of that era, app/data/eras.v1.json `goat: true`). The build fails when an id, source name, nation or era does not match the data (the player must be in that pool). `sofifaId` is EA’s player id (the person: profileId ea:<id>:…). Never a player of data/captains.json.

players.name: Lionel Messi
players.reason: Eight Ballons d’Or between 2009 and 2023, the 2022 World Cup: the best player of four World Cup cycles running — the sextuple side (2010), the 91-goal year (2014), the 2015 treble (2018), the Copa América and the World Cup (2022).

players.name: Cristiano Ronaldo
players.reason: Five Ballons d’Or (2008, 2013, 2014, 2016, 2017), five Champions Leagues, Euro 2016: Manchester United’s 2008 winner (2010) and the Real Madrid goal machine of 2011–18 (2014, 2018).

players.name: Ronaldo
players.reason: O Fenômeno: Ballon d’Or 1997 and 2002, the best player of the 1998 World Cup and the top scorer and winner of 2002 — for many the highest peak a striker has had.

players.name: Zinedine Zidane
players.reason: Ballon d’Or 1998, two goals in the 1998 final, Euro 2000’s best player, the 2002 Champions League final volley, the Golden Ball of the 2006 World Cup.

players.name: Ronaldinho
players.reason: FIFA World Player 2004 and 2005, Ballon d’Or 2005, the 2006 Champions League: two or three years as the most gifted player anyone had seen. One cycle only — his 2002 World Cup was a young man’s, and he faded after 2006.

players.name: Xavi
players.reason: The brain of the Spain of 2008–12 and of Guardiola’s Barcelona: player of Euro 2008, third for the Ballon d’Or three years running (2009–11). A close call: the midfield of the greatest national and club sides of the era, rather than a best-player-in-the-world.

players.name: Andrés Iniesta
players.reason: The 2010 World Cup final’s goal, player of Euro 2012, runner-up for the Ballon d’Or 2010: with Xavi, the midfield everybody else was measured against. A close call, as Xavi.
